1.1_order_state_machine.why: The write-ahead intent -> acknowledged/unknown state machine, the full-journal fail-closed projection (submission_state.py), the executor's refusal while anything is unresolved and the reconciler's lookup by client order id all predate 11-05. The earlier entry here ('NOT_DONE') was wrong: it was based on journal.consistent_window, which was dead code unrelated to this mechanism. tests/autopoiesis/test_order_idempotency.py (8 tests, SYNTHETIC broker, production executor/projection/reconciler) covers: crash after intent across a restart, submit raising, wrong identity in the response, a truncated journal line, recovery by client order id, an unknown the broker cannot find, and a market closed at submit time. Negative control: disabling the executor's unresolved check fails 4 of them. Residual: the loop's 30-minute _identical_order_already_in_flight is a second, weaker guard and is not covered by this file.

1.2_single_trading_permission.why: Admission refuses the sleeve symbol, hold-only symbols, cash ETFs and anything outside the Guardian allowlist (admissible_strategy_symbols). The Guardian's own allowlist remains the single source for what can trade, so the two agree by construction.

1.3_symbol_registry_for_counterfactuals.why: The scoring pass covers configured, served (live strategies) and held symbols (939ad5b); on the real journal that adds 335 rows at no cost. Attention-only picks that no strategy serves are still unscored (sporadic, mostly GAP).

1.5_shadow_vs_fills.why: DecisionRecord.paired: a rule verdict the model overrode is graded but not counted as a fill.

1.6_robust_stats_and_mc.why: Clustered pass bar exists; the W2 Monte Carlo was never run until docs/evidence/goal-2026-11-07/screen_false_pass_mc.json (SYNTHETIC): zero-skill pass rate 2.2% under the current bar vs 49.6% under the old one, 2,000 runs. Batch false-discovery control across the library is not done.

1.7_no_daily_return_target_in_prompt.why: Removed from the curriculum prompt. profit_target_return_pct remains only in the PROFIT_TARGET_CHECKED report payload, which no model reads.

1.8_curriculum_precheck_retry.why: One retry with the rejection reason (41886bb); admissible symbols and the rule-family budget are now stated or enforced (8d5ba1b, d0bddc3). No backoff after repeated refusals.

1.9_information_service.why: The timer now parses and runs (efc0ec9). The refresh uses the data API (ef7399e): real run into scratch gave NVDA earnings 2026-11-17, analyst target, 4 dividends, IV 0.538; ETFs get dividends and IV, Yahoo is empty for funds.
